title: Sync and Async Safe Retry Decorator
instructions: Implement `retry(...)` in `resilience.py`. It must return a decorator that retries both plain functions and `async def` functions, with exponential backoff through the injected `sleep` / `asleep` callables. Await the coroutine inside the `try`, retry only the exceptions in `on`, re-raise the last one unchanged, and keep the function's metadata with `functools.wraps`.

evidence.label: Sync call retries, then succeeds with backoff sleeps [0.5, 1.0]
Sync call gives up and re-raises the last exception object
An async function is really retried and stays a coroutine function
Async call gives up and re-raises the last exception
__name__ and __doc__ are preserved for sync and async
Custom `on` is honoured and arguments are forwarded each attempt
attempts < 1 raises ValueError when the factory is called
